field_notes.tier: 1 = bundled in this repo and testable offline. 2 = read, but not frozen: live pages or documents that cannot be redistributed. 3 = not obtained.
field_notes.completeness: full = the whole document was read. partial = only an extract or index was read. unavailable = could not be obtained.
field_notes.frozen: true = a byte-identical copy is in this repo under 'file', with the sha256 below. false = re-retrieval is required to re-check.
field_notes.limitation: Required whenever completeness is not 'full'. States what this source may NOT be used to establish.
field_notes.supports: Harness check IDs that read this source.
field_notes.issuers: Issuer tokens as they appear in column A of the workbook's 'Credential check' tab.
field_notes.blocks: Open items this source's absence or partiality leaves unresolved.

sources.title: International Building Code, 2024 Edition, Chapter 17 - Special Inspections and Tests
sources.limitation: Section numbers and headings only. This file carries no provision text, so it establishes what a section is CALLED and that it EXISTS - never what it requires. Any claim about the substance of a 2024 IBC provision rests on the full text read during the session, which is not frozen here.

sources.title: ACI 318M-19, Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete, Sec. 26.13 - Inspection
sources.method: extract from the PDF supplied to the session
sources.limitation: Sec. 26.13 only. Supports claims about inspection and inspector qualification under ACI 318-19 and nothing else in that standard. It does not contain AWS D1.4 or CPP 681.x themselves - it only establishes that ACI 318 NAMES them.

sources.title: AWS D1.1/D1.1M:2020, Structural Welding Code - Steel, Sec. 8.1.4 - Inspector Qualification
sources.method: extract from the PDF supplied to the session
sources.limitation: Sec. 8.1.4 only. Establishes the Inspector / Assistant Inspector tier structure and the acceptable qualification bases. It does not establish anything about welding procedures, acceptance criteria, or any other clause of D1.1.

sources.title: ICC, Current Certification Exams - National Exams catalog
sources.established: 47C/47P, 84C/84P, 92C/92P, S1C/S1P, S2C/S2P, ECC/ECP, 86M, 93, B1, B2, CF, 66 are current; 49, 1B, 2B and EC do not appear.

sources.title: ICC special inspector exam listing
sources.established: The modular structure: General Requirements module plus Codes and Plans modules.

sources.title: NICET certification-programs and civil-engineering-technology program pages
sources.established: Current civil programs are CMT Asphalt / Concrete / Soils and Highway Construction Inspection. 'Geotechnical Engineering Technology' is not among them.

sources.title: NICET, Geotechnical Engineering Technology program manual (1994), still hosted by the issuer
sources.limitation: A hosted historical manual. It establishes that the program existed with Levels I-IV and that no withdrawal notice accompanies it. It does NOT establish current status either way - absence from a marketing page is not retirement, and a hosted manual is not an active program.
sources.established: The program existed, Levels I-IV. This is the contradiction behind U-01.

sources.title: PCI personnel certification program overview
sources.established: Plant QC certifications are Level I / II / III; field programs are CFA and CCA. No credential named 'Inspector Level II' exists.

sources.title: AABC certification application and program pages
sources.established: AABC's individual credential is 'Test and Balance Technician'.

sources.title: NEBB certification pages
sources.limitation: Confirms that NEBB technician certifications exist. The exact printed credential name that the matrix should carry was NOT pinned down to an issuer page, which is why the Credential check row for NEBB is marked 'naming' rather than 'current'.
blocks: Credential check row 30 - NEBB credential name not resolved to an issuer page
sources.established: NEBB technician certifications exist.

sources.title: IAPMO initial-certification pages
sources.established: 'UPC Residential and Commercial Plumbing Inspector (PI)' and '...Plans Examiner (PPE)' are exact current matches, codes included.

sources.title: NFCA CAP program page
sources.established: CAP is a Contractor Accreditation Program, not an individual inspector credential.

sources.title: FCIA pages for FM 4991 and the UL firestop examination
sources.established: Both are contractor accreditation routes. FM 4991 is the Standard for the Approval of Firestop Contractors.

sources.title: AWCI EIFS inspector pages and certification registry
sources.established: An EIFS inspector certification with a published registry exists.

sources.title: ACI Shotcrete Inspector program page and certification policy CPP 6611-24
sources.established: Current program, introduced 2020. Full name is 'Shotcrete Inspector'; an Associate level also exists.

sources.title: ASSE 6000-series medical gas personnel certification pages
sources.established: NFPA 99 is the Health Care Facilities Code, not a personnel credential. The personnel certifications are ASSE 6020 and 6030.

sources.title: AWS QC1:2016-AMD1, Standard for AWS Certification of Welding Inspectors
sources.established: A CAWI may inspect only under the active supervision of a CWI or SCWI. Second, independent confirmation of the tier structure in D1.1 Sec. 8.1.4.

sources.title: Hawaii DAGS, adopted Hawaii State Building Code
sources.established: The State adopts the 2018 IBC. This is why Honolulu is on the 2018 IBC and a 2024 update is forward-looking.

sources.title: What DPP's special inspector registry accepts in practice
sources.limitation: IBC 1704.2.1 delegates the competence determination to the building official. DPP IS the authority here, so there is nothing external to check DPP against. This is a structural limit on the whole exercise, not a gap that more research would close.
